scope: Primary source abstracts and selected official documentation, not full-paper replications.

sources.reviewed: Passthrough section and official repository description.
sources.claim: Direct tensor copying and layer stacking are established model-merging operations; the operation itself is not a novelty claim.

sources.reviewed: Primary abstract and official model-card summary.
sources.claim: SOLAR depth up-scaling includes continued pretraining. Its performance is not evidence that layer stacking alone works under our no-training rule.
Unit permutation and alignment matter in model merging. Do not infer compatible functions from matching indices or shapes. Its optimization/alignment algorithms are not imported into this project.

sources.reviewed: Official model-card description and access terms.
sources.claim: Code-specialized pretrained models exist, but that older family is not a verified drop-in donor for our Gemma4 recipient.

prohibited: No fitted permutation,least-squares bridge,optimizer or new training, irrespective of a method being called training-free.
